letter.bill_summary: Pantai Hospital Kuala Lumpur has sent me a bill for RM3,503.30 dated 01 Jul 2026. I have reviewed the bill and found some charges that exceed the legal maximum set by PHFSA Schedule 13 or appear to be unbundled services.
letter.your_rights:
- You are entitled to an itemised bill under the Private Hospitals and Medical Centres Act 1998 (PHFSA 1998).
- You have the right to request clarification on any charge that you dispute.
- You can file a complaint with the hospital within 10 working days of receiving your bill.
- If the hospital does not respond or address your concerns, you can escalate your case to the Ministry of Health Malaysia complaint portal at myhealth.gov.my or call 1-800-88-1000.
action_steps: Call the Hospital Patient Relations Officer at Pantai Hospital Kuala Lumpur on 03-2115 7000 to discuss your concerns.
Request a copy of your itemised bill and review it carefully for any errors or discrepancies.
If you find any errors, contact the hospital's billing department to request clarification.
If the hospital does not respond within 10 working days, file a complaint with the Ministry of Health Malaysia complaint portal at myhealth.gov.my or call 1-800-88-1000.
Consider filing a complaint with the Malaysian Medical Council (MMC) if you believe there was malpractice by a doctor.
If the dispute is worth more than RM50,000, consider taking your case to the Tribunal Tuntutan Pengguna Malaysia (Consumer Claims Tribunal).
As a last resort, consider media/public pressure to raise awareness about the issue.
letter.escalation_guide: Pantai Hospital Kuala Lumpur Patient Relations Officer; Hospital CEO/Management if PRO unresponsive; Ministry of Health Malaysia complaint portal at myhealth.gov.my or call 1-800-88-1000; Malaysian Medical Council (MMC) for doctor-related issues at mmc.gov.my; Tribunal Tuntutan Pengguna Malaysia (Consumer Claims Tribunal) for billing disputes under RM50,000 at ttpm.kpdnhep.gov.my; Media/public pressure as last resort.

hospital_letter.english:
Dear Patient Relations Officer at PANTAI HOSPITAL KUALA LUMPUR,

Re: Bill for TAN MING LOON dated 01 JULY 2026.

I am writing to request a formal review of the charges billed to me, as I have identified several concerns that exceed the legal maximum or above reference price. Specifically:

- Chest X-Ray (PA View): billed RM100.0, cap/reference RM40, source: PHFSA Schedule 13, reason: This charge exceeds the legal maximum of RM40.00 set by PHFSA Schedule 13.

I request that you provide a detailed breakdown of this charge and verify that it was reasonable and justifiable under the Private Healthcare Facilities and Services Act 1998.

Please also investigate the following charges:

- Specialist Consultation (Cardiology) - Initial Visit: billed RM200.0, cap/reference RM235, source: PHFSA Schedule 13 professional fee logic, reason: This charge has been identified as a potential unbundling concern — worth querying with your hospital.

I look forward to your response within 10 working days as provided under the Private Healthcare Facilities and Services Act 1998.

Sincerely,
Tan Ming Loon
hospital_letter.bahasa_malaysia:
Dear Patient Relations Officer at PANTAI HOSPITAL KUALA LUMPUR,

Re: Bill for TAN MING LOON dated 01 JULY 2026.

Saya menulis untuk meminta peninjauan formal atas tagihan yang dikenakan kepada saya, kerana saya telah mengenali beberapa kekhawatiran yang melebihi batas maksimum undang-undang atau harga rujuk yang lebih tinggi. Khususnya:

- Radiografi Pernafasan (PA View): dikenakan RM100.0, cap/reference RM40, sumber: Jadual 13 PHFSA, alasan: Biaya ini melebihi batas maksimum RM40.00 yang ditetapkan oleh Jadual 13 PHFSA.

Saya meminta Anda untuk menyediakan rincian rinci tagihan tersebut dan memastikan bahwa ia rasional dan adil dalam mengenai Undang-Undang Fasiliti Perubatan dan Perkhidmatan 1998.

Sila juga tindak lanjutkan pemeriksaan berikut:

- Konsultasi Khusus (Kardiologi) - Pagi: dikenakan RM200.0, cap/reference RM235, sumber: Jadual 13 PHFSA logik kefaunan profesional, alasan: Biaya ini telah diidentifikasi oleh ahli-ahli kesehatan dan ujaran parlemen sebagai kekhawatiran pembundelan yang potensial — layak untuk diperiksa dengan hospital.

Saya menantikan respons saya dalam 10 hari kerja sejak diwajibkan mengenai Undang-Undang Fasiliti Perubatan dan Perkhidmatan 1998.

Hormat saya,
Tan Ming Loon
